summary: No repository dataset holds neural-spine height profiles together with head/neck/tail mass fractions. MorphoSource has scans for some taxa (47 media for 'Diplodocus') and the PBDB gives occurrence context, but spine heights and segment masses would have to be measured or compiled; searches of Dryad, DataCite and Zenodo returned no measurement tables.
next_step: Compile a table of tallest-spine position and height from published skeletal measurements or scans for a clade-spanning set (anteaters, kangaroos, sauropods, ungulates), and a segment-mass source for the living species; keep reconstructed fossil masses flagged because they depend on the skeleton.
obstacles_confirmed: Soft-tissue mass in fossils is reconstructed indirectly.
